But you have till August 31st to do it so I grabbed my coupon inserts and I. Started to go through them to get as many coupons out in addition to that I. Wanted to do more of the Kotex deals because the $2 coupon it makes it really. Nice so that was the goal shop for free everything today started out at Dollar. General because I assumed that they would have trophies there for about a. Dollar a bag and the coupon was good for a dollar. As usual, I was shopping with Family Dollar. Their ads are always, you know, great ads,. But then when you get to the store, it's a huge disappointment. Either there's not any product, or the price isn't right,. Or, you know, it's just a lot of drama couponing over there. So generally, I don't go there, but I wanted to get the free trollies. For the free movie tickets. So, therefore, I didn't find any there. I headed over to Dollar Tree. Because the goal was to get the trolleys for free. And I was excited. Because I found the right size,. 4.25,. And they had gobs of them. All different kinds of varieties,. And I loved it. So the goal was to get not only this one movie ticket,. But to at least try to get five. So I went ahead and I loaded up on four,. And then I went to another Dollar Tree to get four more. So it's going to be a little bit,. But hopefully I'll be able to reach my goals by at least August the 31st. I checked my haul, make sure they were the right size before I checked out. So then I moved on to CVS because like I said I wanted to do the Kotex deal with them. I hadn't done it yet. And so I went ahead and went over there with my $2 off Kotex coupons. And I loaded up in addition to the Kotex coupons. I still have a lot of ECBs from doing a lot of my double dips, my rain check deals and all of that. So I got a lot of Kotex. And in addition to that I got palm olive fish soap as well. $5 ECB back on Kotex items. I'll sell that. I paid $0.00. So, there's the free shopping. I loaded up the car with all of my items. I'm on the dish soap and Kotex. So, it was another good day. When everything was said and done,. I had about 28 items that I paid zero for. Literally zero. I didn't even have to pay tax on any of my transactions. So I ended up with around 12 Kotex products, 6 bottles of palm olive, I had the 2 receipts.
